item.title: no. 03 · Half a million... for what, exactly?
item.description: DFB president Neuendorf earns around half a million euros a year ("minor" allowances excluded). Half Zurich, half Frankfurt. What he delivers for it can be measured in thirteen episodes, three levels... and zero dissenting votes.
